metadata.name: thesis
metadata.description: Thesis: touch markets on the pm-AMM, resolved by Pyth proofs

instructions.name: claim_creator_fees
docs: Creator: withdraw the earned share of fees attributed to a thesis.

instructions.name: create_thesis
docs: Creator: link their own open conviction market (and optional opposite
protection market) into a public thesis.

instructions.name: create_touch_market
docs: Anyone: create a touch market. The opening price is computed onchain
from a fresh Pyth spot and `Config.sol_vol_bps`; the pm-AMM market's
authority is the `Authority` PDA. Seeded by the creator, or by the
treasury when an admin/keeper sponsors it.

accounts.name: creator
docs: The creator. Pays the TouchMarket rent, and the seed unless sponsored.

accounts.name: creator_usdc
docs: The creator's USDC; required unless `sponsored`.

accounts.name: lp_position
docs: Authority if sponsored, else the creator); pm-AMM checks the seeds.

instructions.name: initialize_config
docs: Admin, once: writes `Config`, funds the `Authority` PDA with SOL for
market rent, and creates the treasury (the Authority's USDC ATA).

accounts.name: authority
docs: System-owned PDA with no data: signs every pm-AMM CPI and pays its rent.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: The treasury: receives the creator half of every swap fee.

instructions.name: prove_touch
docs: Anyone: submit a fully verified Pyth price update that shows the touch.

instructions.name: set_volatility
docs: Keeper or admin: post SOL's annualised volatility (bps).

instructions.name: settle
docs: Anyone, after `end_ts + grace_secs`: resolve YES if touched, else NO.
Records the thesis outcome when its conviction market settles.

accounts.name: cranker
docs: Anyone may crank settlement; the keeper does it by default.

accounts.name: thesis
docs: Required when the market belongs to a thesis (`origin_thesis`).

accounts.name: creator_stats
docs: The thesis creator's stats; required with `thesis`.

instructions.name: trade
docs: Any trader: back, challenge or protect through Thesis so the creator
earns their fee share. Closed once the market is touched.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Receives the creator half of pm-AMM's fee; the balance change is the
fee attributed to this thesis.

instructions.name: treasury_buy_yes
docs: Keeper: after a proven touch, buy underpriced YES with treasury USDC.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin: change any config field; the result must pass `Config::validate`.

fields.name: creator_share_bps
docs: Creator share of the treasury's swap fee, in bps (5000 at launch).

fields.name: lp_rebate_bps
docs: Share of creator fees rebated to LPs (0 at launch; v2).

fields.name: grace_secs
docs: Seconds after `end_ts` during which a late proof may still land.

fields.name: max_conf_bps
docs: Max Pyth confidence as a share of price, in bps.

fields.name: sponsor_budget
docs: Treasury USDC still available for sponsored seeds (launch subsidy).

fields.name: sol_vol_bps
docs: SOL annualised volatility in bps (6000 = 60%), set by the keeper.

fields.name: max_vol_age_secs
docs: Market creation fails if `sol_vol_bps` is older than this.

fields.name: max_spot_age_secs
docs: Market creation needs a spot price no older than this.

fields.name: min_strike_distance_bps
docs: Strike distance from spot, in bps of spot (spec: 0.5%..50%).

fields.name: min_open_bps
docs: Allowed opening probability, in bps (spec: 1%..99%).

fields.name: market_id
docs: pm-AMM market id. pm-AMM ids share one namespace across every user of
the pm-AMM, and any id the program derived would be predictable (so
easier to squat). Clients send a random u64 and retry with a new one if
the CPI reports the market account already exists.

fields.name: strike
docs: Strike in the same exponent as the spot price update.

fields.name: sponsored
docs: Seed from the treasury (admin/keeper only, within `sponsor_budget`)
instead of from the creator's own USDC.

fields.name: authority_funding
docs: Lamports moved to the Authority PDA to pay pm-AMM rent.

fields.name: conviction_market
docs: TouchMarket PDA the crowd backs or challenges.

fields.name: protection_market
docs: TouchMarket PDA for the creator's cover; default = none.

fields.name: text_hash
docs: sha256 of the thesis text (text lives offchain).

fields.name: volume_usdc
docs: USDC moved by trades routed through `trade` (both markets).

fields.name: self_volume_usdc
docs: Part of `volume_usdc` traded by the creator's own wallet.

fields.name: fees_attributed
docs: Treasury fee income from trades routed through `trade`.

fields.name: fees_claimed
docs: Creator share already paid out.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 0 open, 1 hit (conviction market touched), 2 missed.

fields.name: strike
docs: Strike in Pyth units: real price = strike * 10^expo.

fields.name: winning_side
docs: 0 = unresolved, 1 = YES, 2 = NO (same encoding as pm-AMM).

fields.name: seeded_by
docs: Authority PDA for sponsored markets, else the creator.

fields.name: spot_at_open
docs: Pyth spot the opening price was computed from.

types.name: TradeSide
docs: What a trader does through `trade`. Buys spend USDC; sells receive it.

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Every field optional: only the ones sent change.
